message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (for a standard 108‑card deck)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or play a set number of rounds). Points are earned by being the first to discard all cards in your hand and then scoring the sum of the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Turn over the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). On a turn you may either:
1. **Play** one card from your hand that matches the color, number, or symbol of the top discard card.
2. **Draw** one card from the draw pile if you cannot or choose not to play. | | **Playing Cards** | • **Number cards** (0–9) match by number or color.
• **Action cards**:
 - **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
 - **Reverse** – changes play direction.
 - **Draw Two (+2)** – next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
 - **Wild** – you choose the new color.
 - **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color cards.) | | **Drawing** | If you draw a playable card, you may immediately play it. Otherwise, keep it and end your turn. | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty: the player who caught you must draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the total value of all cards still held by opponents:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Game End** | The first player to reach 500 points (or the agreed target) wins the game. | --- ### Quick Play Tips 1. **Keep track of colors** – try to hold onto a variety of colors so you’re never forced to draw. 2. **Use Wilds strategically** – save them for when you need to change the color to avoid drawing. 3. **Watch the discard pile** – remember what cards have been played to anticipate opponents’ moves. 4. **Plan for the endgame** – if you’re close to winning, consider playing high‑value cards early to reduce your own score. Enjoy your game!
